name: jelly-desktop
description: Jelly, a soft-body desktop pet for macOS that catches your screenshots and files
author: Chi Min Lee (catsmice)

scripts.install-app: npm run app && rm -rf /Applications/Jelly.app && cp -R dist/mac-arm64/Jelly.app /Applications/ && echo "Installed /Applications/Jelly.app"

extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: Jelly catches new screenshots when macOS saves them to the Desktop.
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Jelly catches new screenshots in the folder you chose for them.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: Jelly catches downloads as they finish, when Fetch downloads is on.
